abortion.summary: Howard states she opposed anti-abortion bills in the legislature and supports protecting access to abortion and reproductive healthcare in Pennsylvania, citing the principles of Roe v. Wade.
abortion.short: Opposes anti-abortion bills; supports protecting abortion access

education.summary: Howard says she supports making Pennsylvania community colleges and PASSHE state universities tuition-free for families who need help, and fully funding public education.
education.short: Supports tuition-free community college and full public-school funding

healthcare.summary: Howard states she supported Medicaid expansion and says she is working across party lines to negotiate with insurers and drugmakers to lower healthcare and prescription costs.
healthcare.short: Supported Medicaid expansion; works to lower healthcare, drug costs

energy.summary: Howard states she supports a green energy future that does not rely on carbon-based sources and supports taxing fracking to reflect its health and environmental costs.
energy.short: Supports green energy transition; supports taxing fracking

guns.summary: Howard states she is working to bring red flag legislation to a vote and has proposed gun measures including firearm intoxication penalties, an assault weapons buy-back program, and trespassing-related penalties.
guns.short: Supports red flag law; proposes additional gun reforms
